name: Comeback List
office_task: Every weekday morning, pick the past customers from our job history who are due a check-up or have not used us in a year, say why each one, and draft a short text for me to send.
systems_of_record: the job system (ServiceM8, Simpro, Fergus, Tradify or AroFlo) that holds each customer, their completed jobs with the job_id, the last outcome and the do-not-contact flag
the place the owner opens each morning (job system tasks, a shared sheet or a morning email), which issues the report_id for each day's list

emits.write: the day's list for the owner: at most the cap they set, in rank order, each row with its play, the true reason that qualified it, the job_id of the customer's last completed job, a drafted text of at most 50 words naming the business with a way to opt out, and the last outcome. Drafts only: nothing is sent or dialled
emits.readback: the list store returns a report_id for the day's list, and reading that id back returns the same rows in the same order; no id back means no list was published and the run raises an exception

emits.write: a thing to sort out, on top of the list and naming the person who owns it: a customer missing name, mobile or site address, or a reply waiting that asks for a price, makes a complaint or asks something the play was not built for
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the customer, the typed reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
